title: Tooltip Orbit
description: Bài học: chú thích quay quanh điểm neo bằng lò xo và đổi sang phía còn chỗ (trên, dưới, trái) khi điểm neo đi sát mép khung, chữ luôn đứng thẳng.

moworks.notes: Anchor dot r13 moves (150,104) → (150,52) at 0.3-0.85 s, holds, → (256,112) at 1.85-2.4 s, holds, back at 3.3-3.85 s (power2.inOut). A 78x24 r6 label orbits it on an ellipse 66 x 36 px; its angle follows springs k170 c22 (sum): −90° (top) → 90° (bottom) at 0.95 s → 180° (left) at 2.5 s → 270° (top) at 3.55 s; the label stays upright with a small arrow pointing at the anchor. Frame edges flash accent where the label would overflow. Params: anchor path [[giây, x, y]] · orbit (66 x 36 px) · spring (k170 c22) · sides (top → bottom → left). A lesson: the label orbits its anchor on springs and moves to the side that has room when the anchor nears an edge; the text stays upright.
